weapons.name: Daybreak

weapons.why: Hurls sun spears that stick to enemies and inflict Daybroken.

weapons.why: Swings a long whipsword that passes through blocks and pierces infinitely.

weapons.name: Terra Blade

weapons.why: Fires a fast green sword beam projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Flying Dragon

armor.name: Beetle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Beetle Husks and Turtle Armor

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: It is still easy free value before every important fight.

weapons.name: Nebula Blaze

weapons.why: Fires high-velocity homing typhoons that pierce enemies and bounce off blocks.

weapons.name: Bubble Gun

weapons.why: Rapidly fires a short-range spread of bubbles.

armor.name: Spectre Armor
armor.why: The Mask converts magic damage into damage; the Hood converts 40% of it into healing.

armor.name: Spectre Hood Loadout
